mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 72 degree temperatures near the Military Ridge State Trail with a moderate air quality index of 52. Tonight, you can spot the International Space Station starting at 9:08 PM, as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels toward the Northeast heading near Home Depot for a four minute show.

In city news, Verona officers responded to a burglary and weapons offence on September 10th on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended with a handgun. Additionally, the city has posted various election notices for the upcoming November general election.

There is plenty to do in our community. We have live music today at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Macs. Looking ahead, get ready for the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in town on September 13th.

During a residential burglary on September 10th, Verona police officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where they successfully apprehended a suspect after a firearm was discharged.
Enjoy the Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day at the Verona Culver's. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM.
